# Health Committees

This folder contains steering committees and advisory groups responsible for overseeing national clinical quality databases and developing evidence-based care indicators. It currently houses the central decision-making body for the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (DANIBD). This committee evaluates clinical outcomes, sets national development targets, and issues recommendations to improve patient monitoring and treatment across Danish hospital departments.

## Pages

- [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] — The central steering committee that oversees the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases, defining quality indicators, evaluating surgical and diagnostic outcomes, and issuing clinical recommendations to hospitals.
